recipes.name: Hamburguesas Mexicanas
ingredients_raw: salt and ground black pepper to taste
1 head iceberg lettuce, cored and shredded

steps.text: Combine ground beef, ½ onions, pepper Jack cheese, bread crumbs, and eggs in a bowl; form into 12 patties.
Combine tomatoes, ½ remaining onions, cilantro, ½ lime juice, and ½ serrano in a bowl; stir well. Cover pico de gallo; refrigerate to chill.
Mash avocados, remaining ½ onions, remaining ½ lime juice, and remaining ½ serrano together in a bowl; season guacamole with salt and black pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add patties; cook to desired doneness, 3 to 5 minutes per side. An instant-read thermometer inserted into centers should read 160 degrees F (70 degrees C).
Place 1 burger on each bun; top with guacamole, shredded lettuce, and pico de gallo.

raw_recipe.headline: Hamburguesas Mexicanas
raw_recipe.description: This hamburguesas Mexicanas recipe yields Mexican-style burgers laced with pepper Jack cheese and onions, topped with pico de gallo and guacamole.

review.reviewBody: This is, hands down, one of the best burgers that I have tried from this site and definitely worthy of more than 5 stars! Aside from scaling the recipe down for 2 burgers, adding some salt to the pico and a little garlic powder to the guacamole, I kept the recipe the same. Served these on toasted buns. All of the flavors blended perfectly...DELICIOUS! I will be making these often~YUM! Thanks for sharing. :)

This was a great burger! I scaled it down to fix only 4. I used all jalapeño peppers, but it wasn’t spicy enough for us, so next time I will use hotter peppers and some cayenne pepper and/or Mexican chili powder in the burger. I added some sour cream to my guacamole spread making it thick and creamy. My husband said it was restaurant quality, which is his highest praise.
A nice change from plain hamburgers. Next time I think we will just add sliced pepperjack on the burgers.
Great. Followed beef recipe exactly then topped with guac shredded lettuce and pico.

Easily one of the best burgers I've had with slight changes. I grilled the burgers on the BBQ, added garlic salt to taste in the guacamole and used lightly toasted sandwich thins. Great recipe. Thank you DonnaB.

Loved these. Fantastic flavor, and I was doubtful initially because the recipe didn't call for any "seasonings" beyond the pico and guacamole, really. I think a lot of the great flavor was because I used bison meat (seriously, it's so much yummier than your standard ground beef and healthier too!) but it was mostly just a great recipe. And by the time I mixed in all the onions and so on into my meat, I had enough to make about twice the patties (2oz meat per patty), which was awesome - I could have two burgers for the guilt of one! :) Thank you for the recipe; these burgers were delicious!
good, we all liked, but no one raved...I think i might tweek the spices next time to our liking. Thanks for a good base recipe.
Stuck to the recipe. The burgers went over very well with the whole family. Yummy.
